security_spec.violation_condition: OpenSBI platform firmware compiled against IOPMP v0.8 register layout reads/writes HWCFG0 at MMIO offset 0x08 using old bit positions for fields (chk_x@bit10, peis@bit12, pees@bit13, sps_en@bit5, stall_en@bit11, mfr_en@bit15, prient_prog@bit7, rrid_transl_en@bit8, rrid_transl_prog@bit9, no_x@bit11, no_w@bit12, mdcfg_fmt@bits[1:0], srcmd_fmt@bits[3:2], md_entry_num@bits[22:16]) that have relocated to HWCFG2 (offset 0x10) and new HWCFG3 (offset 0x14) in v0.8.1; also ENTRYOFFSET accessed at old offset 0x14 now aliases HWCFG3
security_spec.vulnerability_pattern: IOPMP_HWCFG0 bitfield access using v0.8 layout (search: hwcfg0\.(chk_x|peis|pees|sps_en|stall_en|mfr_en|no_x|no_w|rrid_transl_en|rrid_transl_prog|mdcfg_fmt|srcmd_fmt|md_entry_num|prient_prog|user_cfg_en)) OR hardcoded ENTRYOFFSET at 0x14
security_spec.summary: IOPMP v0.8→v0.8.1 reorganizes HWCFG regs: HWCFG0 shrinks to enable/HWCFG2_en/HWCFG3_en/md_num/addrh_en/tor_en; chk_x/peis/pees/sps_en/stall_en/mfr_en/prio_entry move to HWCFG2; no_x/no_w/rrid_transl/mdcfg_fmt/srcmd_fmt/md_entry_num move to new HWCFG3; ENTRYOFFSET shifts 0x14→0x2C; firmware using old layout reads reserved bits (all zero) and silently disables DMA execute-check/interrupt-suppression/error-suppression

findings.finding: OpenSBI contains no IOPMP driver code, register definitions, or MMIO access for IOPMP hardware. The only IOPMP reference is a single documentary mention in domain_support.md line 7 listing IOPMP as a potential platform isolation feature alongside PMP/ePMP/SiFive Shield. No source or header files define HWCFG0 (offset 0x08), HWCFG2 (offset 0x10), HWCFG3 (offset 0x14), or ENTRYOFFSET (offset 0x2C) registers. No code reads or writes any IOPMP bitfields (chk_x, peis, pees, sps_en, stall_en, mfr_en, prient_prog, rrid_transl_en, rrid_transl_prog, no_x, no_w, mdcfg_fmt, srcmd_fmt, md_entry_num) at any register offset. Therefore the v0.8-to-v0.8.1 register layout mismatch (fields relocated from HWCFG0 to HWCFG2/HWCFG3, ENTRYOFFSET moved from 0x14 to 0x2C) cannot manifest as a bug in this codebase.
findings.snippet:
The OpenSBI will try to achieve secure isolation between domains using RISC-V platform
features such as PMP, ePMP, IOPMP, SiFive Shield, etc.

Important entities which help implement OpenSBI domain support are:

spec_citations.excerpt: HWCFG0_OFFSET = 0x08, HWCFG1_OFFSET = 0x0C, HWCFG2_OFFSET = 0x10, HWCFG3_OFFSET = 0x14, ENTRYOFFSET_OFFSET = 0x2C (v0.8.1+). Fields spread across HWCFG0/HWCFG2/HWCFG3.
